snippet.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Complete Edition | “Geralt & Ciri” Trailer
snippet.description:
Starting today, you’ll be able to get a box edition of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Complete Edition for @PlayStation 5 and @XBOX Series X from your local store! 💿

Check the regional availability at http://thewitcher.ly/W3box-dates

For more information about The Witcher visit:
